analysis: Market environment: S&P 500 in a broad consolidation/recovery after a significant drawdown. The screened universe shows 30 quality names, but most are in MIXED/SIDEWAYS trends with negative SMA50 slopes — those fail the 'trend has stopped going down' timing filter. Three standouts pass both the fundamental and technical bars: FDS (13% of 52w range, UPTREND basing), ROP (15% of 52w range, UPTREND basing), and PYPL (29% of 52w range, UPTREND basing with strong SMA50 slope of +3.2%). All three are quality businesses trading materially below their 52-week highs, with confirmed early-stage uptrends — the ideal Stage 1→2 transition. Candidates with negative SMA50 slopes (MSFT, V, MCO, CI, ADSK, GPN, etc.) are skipped regardless of quality — timing is not confirmed. COIN is excluded due to high ATR (6%) and revenue decline of -22%. APP and DDOG are too extended above SMA50 (+19.9% and +7.9% respectively after recent runs). Deploying roughly 70-75% of equity across 3 concentrated positions, keeping ~25-30% in cash as a buffer.

trades.entry_strategy: Limit order at $224 or market open; alternatively wait for a 1-2 day pullback toward $220 if market opens weak. Do not chase above $230.
trades.rationale: Fundamental: FactSet is a wide-moat financial data and analytics provider with 28.1% ROE, 29.8% operating margin, $590M FCF, and a forward P/E of just 11.56 — genuinely cheap for this quality tier. Revenue growth of 7.1% is steady and recurring (subscription model). The business is essentially an oligopoly alongside Bloomberg and Refinitiv. Technical: Price sits at only 13% of the 52-week range (near the low), confirmed UPTREND with basing pattern, SMA50 slope turning positive at +0.5%. Price is +3% above SMA50 but still -20% below SMA200 — plenty of room to recover before becoming extended. This is classic early-stage base breakout territory.
trades.exit_plan: Exit if price closes two consecutive days below $210 stop. Thesis break: any sustained deterioration in subscriber count or revenue growth turning negative. Time stop: reassess at 6 months if target not reached. Hold through earnings unless a clear downside revision to guidance. Trim 1/3 at $255 to de-risk, let remainder run toward LTCG if thesis intact past 12 months.

trades.entry_strategy: Limit at $50.00 or on any intraday pullback to the $49-50 range. Avoid chasing above $52. SMA50 is rising at +3.2% slope — ideal to enter near or slightly below current price on a red day.
trades.rationale: Fundamental: PayPal trades at a forward P/E of 8.70 and PEG of 0.91 — deeply undervalued relative to its earnings power. ROE of 25.7%, operating margin of 17.5%, and $3.3B FCF demonstrate a high-quality payments franchise. Revenue growth (3.7%) looks soft but active account monetization and Venmo monetization are improving. New CEO (Alex Chriss) is executing a strategic refocus. At this price, the market is pricing in permanent stagnation — unlikely given the franchise strength. Technical: UPTREND basing with the strongest SMA50 slope among candidates (+3.2%), price at 29% of 52w range, and +7.5% above SMA50 but only -14.5% below SMA200. The trend has clearly reversed from its lows. Basing pattern is intact — this is not a chase.
trades.exit_plan: Stop at $47.80 closes the trade. Thesis break: if transaction volume or take-rate trends deteriorate materially in next two earnings prints, reassess. Trim 1/3 at $60 to lock in partial gains. Hold remainder for potential LTCG treatment if thesis stays intact past 12 months. Time stop: if price has not progressed above $57 within 4 months, reassess.

trades.entry_strategy: Limit at $354 or current market. Do not pay above $362. Acceptable to scale in with a second tranche on any 3-5% pullback to $340-345 (near SMA50).
trades.rationale: Fundamental: Roper Technologies is a serial acquirer of niche software and technology businesses with 27.2% operating margins, 11.3% revenue growth, and $2.2B FCF. The asset-light model (P/B of 1.9 is low for this quality) generates high returns on invested capital. Forward P/E of 14.87 is attractive for a compounder of this caliber — historically it has traded at 25-30x. Technical: Price is at only 15% of the 52-week range, in a confirmed UPTREND with basing characteristics. SMA50 slope is positive (+0.5%) and price is essentially at SMA50 (+0.4%), making this a low-risk entry point just emerging from the base. Still -18.7% below SMA200 — significant room to recover before becoming extended.
trades.exit_plan: Hard stop at $338 (close below). Thesis break: if Roper announces a large, dilutive acquisition outside its software focus, or if FCF deteriorates meaningfully. Trim 1/3 at $395 to reduce risk. Hold remaining position toward LTCG threshold if business execution remains on track. Time stop: reassess in 6 months if price has stalled below $375.
